rca_of_the_issue: Mobile accordion crash (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined) - Root Cause: The desktop right column code (lines 315-335) accessed SOLUTIONS[activeSolution] unconditionally. On mobile, clicking accordion to collapse sets activeSolution to -1, making SOLUTIONS[-1] undefined. Even though desktop column is hidden via CSS (hidden lg:grid), React still evaluates the JSX. Fix: Added conditional check `activeSolution >= 0 && SOLUTIONS[activeSolution]` before rendering.
